ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 8, 20, 31-34; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended; beneficial ownership information must be collected and maintained by the licensed registered agent in Samoa and is accessible by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour upon lawful request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the shareholder's passport bio-data page
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the shareholder's country of residence or nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; otherwise Consular Legalization at the nearest Samoa diplomatic or consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each ultimate beneficial owner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming banking relationship, reputation, and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The applicant's existing or proposed banking institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and corporate due diligence questionnaire

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence on all directors, shareholders, and UBOs; enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons and their family members or close associates; positive-match screening against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, Samoa domestic watchlists, and adverse-media databases; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification; ongoing transaction monitoring and record retention for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MCIL Samoa Companies Registry - International Companies Registration Office (applications submitted through licensed Samoa registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English and Samoan are official languages. International company names must be in Latin script or accompanied by a registered English/Samoan transliteration. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must end with the word 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd'. Names containing restricted words are subject to prior ministerial or regulatory approval.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations may not be extended; after the 30-day reservation window expires, the applicant must re-file the name clearance application. Upon rejection, the applicant through its licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days, attaching evidence of distinguishability, the required regulatory consent for any restricted token, and the applicable filing fee. If the Registrar confirms the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 28 days of the reconsideration decision. Judicial review remains available in the Supreme Court of Samoa.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for Samoa International Companies. A virtual office at the licensed registered agent's physical street address in Apia satisfies the registered office requirement, provided it is not a mere P.O. Box, all official mail is accepted, and the agent maintains the statutory registers. No local physical trading premises or commercial substance in Samoa is required for a non-resident Amazon FBA business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; less than 5% annual probability for a compliant non-resident IC. The risk may rise to approximately 20-30% if sanctions or PEP flags are present, or if the registered agent's address is linked to prior non-compliance, shell-like activity, or adverse regulatory findings.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008), sections 6 to 15 and 27 to 31; Memorandum and Articles of Association requirements under sections 10 and 11.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is imposed; an International Company may commence business with one share of no par value. There is no statutory escrow account or capital deposit requirement before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the allotment and issue of one ordinary share to the subscriber named in the Statement of Subscriber as fully paid is approved; (2) the registered office of the Company shall be at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; (3) [Name] is appointed as Director and [Name] as Secretary, each to serve until removed; (4) the officers are authorised to file the incorporation documents, pay statutory fees, open bank and payment accounts, and execute ancillary contracts; (5) the accounting reference date is set as [date]. This resolution takes effect immediately. CARRIED.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Licensed Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry via a licensed registered agent; online portal of MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a licensed Samoa registered agent to conduct a name search and submit the proposed name to the Registrar. The proposed name must end with Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Ltd., Corp., or Inc. Provide notarised identity evidence for the proposed director and shareholder simultaneously.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (with one alternative)
Licensed registered agent engagement letter and consent
Notarised copy of passport of each subscriber and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, a revised name is re-submitted within one business day at no additional government fee; the name reservation priority may be held for up to 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and a notary public in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber must execute the documents before a notary, and each proposed director and secretary must sign consent to act. The registered agent must consent to act as registered agent and maintain the registered office.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed originals)
Consent to act forms for each director and the secretary
Registered office address consent and registered agent consent
Notarised subscriber execution page
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to any provision, the constitution documents may be amended by written resolution of the subscriber and re-executed within three business days without fresh government fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents, and the prescribed government filing fee. Filing may be completed by the registered agent physically at the MCIL counters or through the agent's authorised electronic lodgement portal. Payment of the government fee is made in United States dollars or Samoan tala equivalent.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of initial director and secretary
Government filing fee receipt
Registered agent due diligence file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an application is queried, the registered agent is notified by the Registrar and may file an explanatory legend or supplementary consent. Corrections must be submitted within five business days to avoid recommencement of the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all filing requirements, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the official seal. The certificate records the company name, registration number, and date of incorporation. The company is constituted as a separate legal entity from the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
Filed copies of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of registered office and registered agent
Entry in the International Companies Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error or omission, the Registrar shall amend the certificate on written request and issue a certified corrected copy under section 35 of the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Officer Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (by unanimous written resolution; physical meeting not required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting by written resolution to approve the issue of shares, adopt the registered office, confirm the registered agent, appoint officers, and authorise the opening of bank and payment accounts. Execute share certificates and open the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Register of directors, secretary, and charges
Register of members (share ledger)
Share certificates for issue
Board consent and conflict of interest declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a vacancy in officer appointment exists, the board may pass a subsequent written resolution; no re-filing with the Registrar is required for internal officer appointments unless the registered agent details change.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent, board of directors, and Ministry for Revenue (Samoa Revenue Service) as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the statutory registers at the registered office, submit the annual return and annual renewal fees to the Registrar, obtain a Tax Identification Number where needed for banking or Amazon seller verification, and complete onboarding with the target payment rails (“Amazon Pay”, “Stripe”, “Airwallex”) using certified corporate documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation certified copy
Register of directors and secretary
Annual return and renewal receipt
Tax identification number certificate (where applicable)
Amazon seller agreement or FBA seller account registration
Payment rail account application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a renewal or annual filing is rejected, the registered agent files an updated return with covering explanation and, where applicable, applies to the Registrar for reinstatement before the date of strike-off. Late filing penalties are cured by payment and re-compliance under the Registrar's remedial procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Trade and Industrial Licensing Division (not applicable to pure online marketplace retail)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - no physical retail, storage, or manufacturing establishment is operated in Samoa; all inventory is fulfilled by third-party logistics under the Amazon FBA model

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa, with the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no land development, construction, manufacturing, or stationary emission source; retail activity is electronic in nature
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge, wastewater, or VOC emissions arise. If a local office or fulfilment facility is later established, compliance with the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004, Water and Sewerage Act, and Waste Management Regulations will apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable as no physical store, factory, or warehouse is occupied in Samoa. If a commercial office is subsequently opened, a fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority and a building occupancy clearance will be required under the Fire and Emergency Services Act 2013.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Inland Revenue Division (Samoa); official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoa International Company is statutorily tax-exempt and is not ordinarily required to obtain a national tax identification number (TIN) for income tax. If the IC nonetheless registers for VAGST (voluntarily or due to taxable local supply), it must file Form VAGST-REG with the Ministry for Revenue, supported by the Certificate of Incorporation, Registered Office Declaration, and identification of the Samoa agent/registered office provider. The Ministry issues a TIN / VAGST registration number upon approval. For non-tax-exempt resident entities, a TIN is issued through the Revenue Register within the same Ministry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, transparent-entity, or hybrid-mismatch elections are available for Samoa International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987. The entity is absolutely exempt from Samoa income tax, and there is no mechanism to elect into entity-level taxation. Registered VAGST persons may elect to group related entities for VAGST purposes under the discretion of the Ministry for Revenue, but this does not alter the IC's underlying tax-exempt classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 per 12-month period (or such gazetted higher amount) of taxable supplies; monthly tracking is required once cumulative supplies exceed 50% of the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance APIs, or digital stamping. Registered VAGST suppliers must issue sequential VAGST tax invoices (paper or electronic PDF) containing the seller's name, registration number, date, description, amount, and VAGST component. No pre-clearance or government API clearance exists.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2003, a supply is zero-rated if the goods are exported from Samoa by or on behalf of the supplier, or the services are physically performed outside Samoa and supplied to a non-resident. An International Company engaged in cross-border e-commerce/FBA may claim zero-rating only if it is a registered VAGST person and the goods leave Samoa and are delivered to an offshore marketplace warehouse or customer; pure offshore digital/fulfilment services without local leakage may be outside the VAGST net entirely.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoan Customs Export Declaration (export entry form)
Bill of Lading or Airwaybill evidencing physical removal from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank FX receipt showing export proceeds credited to the IC's Samoa bank account
Third-party evidence of delivery into the offshore FBA/Amazon warehouse
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating attracts a tax shortfall penalty of 100% of the VAGST sought to be refused or refunded, plus an additional 50% in the case of intentional evasion, compound interest from the due date, and full retrospective clawback of any refund paid. Criminal prosecution may extend to directors and the registered agent, with maximum fines of WST 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment. Audited customs export records, courier manifests, and bank receipts must be retained for at least 7 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa / CBS), acting as the sole exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, and the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a conventional peg to a trade-weighted basket dominated by USD, AUD, NZD and EUR. Current-account payments are convertible through authorised dealer banks upon presentation of underlying invoices and customs or service documentation. Capital-account transactions (equity, loans, portfolio flows) and resident foreign-currency accounts require CBS approval. For a non-resident Samoa International Company (WS_IC), the International Companies Act 1988 confers a statutory exemption from the Exchange Control Act 1976 for offshore business conducted in foreign currency; therefore profit remittance, dividends and liquidation proceeds payable to non-residents from offshore foreign-currency accounts are freely remittable and are not subject to Samoa withholding tax. Material hurdles arise only if funds are converted into WST or passed through a domestic-resident account, in which case CBS Form EC applications, an authorised dealer, and a tax clearance certificate are required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, the full foreign-currency value of exported goods must be received within six months of the export date and must be tendered for sale to an authorised dealer within one month of receipt. No fixed statutory percentage of conversion into WST is prescribed; the CBS may direct conversion on a transaction-by-transaction basis. For the WS_IC Amazon FBA model, physical export of goods into Samoa is de minimis (inventory moves from supplier warehouses directly to Amazon fulfilment centres), so the surrender rule is practically engaged only on cargo landed in Samoa. Export receipts credited to an exempt offshore foreign-currency account of the IC are outside the surrender obligation provided the account is properly designated and reported through the IC's licensed registered agent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_commenta: Annexed for completeness: exporters must retain customs export declarations, shipping bills, sales contracts, and bank credit advices as the evidentiary bundle supporting the six-month repatriation timeline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Multi-Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account / Export Proceeds Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM-HIGH as a payment collection rail and LOW-MEDIUM as a replacement for a full bank account. Payoneer and similar EMIs can onboard a Samoa IC for Amazon marketplace settlements; Airwallex and Stripe generally restrict or conditionally accept Samoa-incorporated entities on jurisdiction-risk grounds. The IC may lawfully hold foreign-currency funds offshore without CBS approval, but no WST conversion may occur outside an authorised dealer channel. Recommended treasury architecture: use the EMI as a collection sweep layer only, executing daily MT103 sweeps to the ANZ or BSP Samoa anchor account, which remains the juridical liquidity hub.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one natural-person director or senior authorised signatory, accompanied by the licensed Samoa registered agent, must attend an in-person KYC interview at the chosen domestic bank's Apia branch before account activation. Fully remote onboarding without any physical presence is generally not accepted by Tier-1 domestic banks. ANZ and BSP offer a hybrid model: in-person interview for the primary signatory, with remaining directors verified by video identification, apostilled corporate documents, and a banker's reference from the shareholder's home bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer-share or opaque ownership structure of a Samoa International Company, automatically screened as high-risk by correspondent banks and EMI payment providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written confirmation from the registered agent that no bearer shares are issued or in circulation; register of directors and members filed with the licensed registered agent; current beneficial-ownership declaration; certified copy of the offshore trust deed where the IC is trust-held; five-year corporate registry search; legal opinion from Samoa counsel confirming economic substance and governance compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border marketplace receipts (Amazon) with mismatched ordering-party names and high-frequency volumetric retail payouts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Seller Central registration certificate; Fulfillment By Amazon services agreement; 90-day settlement reports and payout statements; Amazon seller identification, VAT and EIN documentation; logistics and supplier invoices evidencing inventory purchase; loan-out or supplier-resale agreements executed in the IC name.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Immediate round-trip movement where injected capital is wired out rapidly to shareholders or suppliers in a pattern resembling money laundering or tax evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution approving the equity injection and deployment purpose; share subscription and allotment register; funds-flow memorandum; commercial supply or inventory contracts; pro-forma invoices; corporate registry extract; director declaration of source and purpose of funds; CBS exchange-control approval or exemption confirmation where tala conversion is involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of wealth for a web-based retail entity with no physical operational footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements of the ultimate beneficial owner; audited or certified management accounts of the IC; tax clearance certificate from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue; notarised interview sign-off; reference letter from the shareholder's primary bank; e-commerce and marketplace registration evidence (Amazon, Google, domain and platform verification).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity capital injection must be executed by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home bank to the WS_IC account in Samoa or to the third-country settlement account. Required wire protocol: beneficiary name exactly matching the account title of WS_IC; purpose code and field 70 narrative 'EQUITY CAPITAL INJECTION – IC SHARE ALLOTMENT – REF [allotment number]'; prior filing of the share allotment return with the Samoa registered agent; board resolution authorising the capital call; OFAC, EU and UN interdiction screening; and CBS Form EC-A exchange-control application where WST conversion is required. The Samoa bank will also require a source-of-funds letter, CRS self-certification, and underlying allotment documentation. For USD retention, the account should be opened as USD or dual-currency WST/USD to avoid involuntary conversion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements use four clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 supplier payments and Amazon fee settlements with field 70 purpose codes ('SUPPLY INVENTORY', 'AMAZON MARKETPLACE FEES', 'FBA LOGISTICS'); (ii) commercial Letters of Credit under UCP600 for large inventory purchases from Asian suppliers, typically sight LCs confirmed through Hong Kong or Singapore banks; (iii) EMI collection rails (Amazon Pay to Payoneer or Airwallex) with daily sweeping to the Samoa anchor account; and (iv) domestic WST transfers for local operating expenses. Correspondent corridors are ANZ Sydney (AUD/USD), BSP Port Moresby and Sydney, with standard USD clearing through major US correspondent banks. All outbound wires require the underlying invoice or contract to be retained on file in accordance with Samoa AML/CFT and exchange-control documentation rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla deliverable FX forwards (USD/WST, AUD/WST, NZD/WST) up to 12 months with an authorised dealer, permitted only against committed underlying receipts or payables
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST for offshore hedging of illiquid tala exposure, net cash-settled in USD
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for matched equity-injection and intercompany-loan exposure
FX swaps and rollovers for short-term liquidity management between USD, AUD and WST
Spot FX conversion onshore via authorised dealers with documented underlying commercial purpose; uncovered speculative positions are prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and annual government fee payment for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of the date of incorporation, each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty applied immediately; continued default may trigger administrative strike-off of the International Company, with forfeiture of assets and dissolution of legal personality

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a standard Samoa International Company; audit is required only where the company holds a licence under the International Banking Act, International Insurance Act, or International Trusts Act, or where ordered by the Registrar
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework for offshore International Companies; IFRS is acceptable as best practice and financial records must be sufficient to explain transactions and give a true and fair view

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO confirmation filing is required; the registered agent must maintain the beneficial ownership register continuously and note any shareholding transfer within the annual return, together with any changes notified in the prescribed form

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% general corporate income tax rate; International Company (IC) operating in the tax-exempt zone: 0% on non-Samoa-source income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption for an International Company under Section 209 of the International Companies Act 1987, subject to conditions: no Samoa-source income, no business with Samoan residents, and payment of the annual government fee. The effective income tax rate is 0% on offshore e-commerce and FBA trading income; no dividend withholding tax; no capital gains tax; no stamp duty on exempt operations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Exempt International Company Annual Return (Form AR-IC01) filed via the licensed Registered Agent with the Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; this is the only recurrent filing required for a tax-exempt IC and is separate from the Ministry for Revenue income tax system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after each anniversary of the certificate of incorporation, together with payment of the annual government fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number and jurisdiction status (International Company).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must exactly match the Certificate of Incorporation and the International Companies Register; non-resident owners should use the official English name as registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Samoa maintained by the licensed Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Samoan address (not a P.O. Box) is required; the Registered Agent is the statutory point of service for Samoan authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered Agent certificate and confirmation of good standing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a valid license under the International Companies Act 1987 and must certify the IC is compliant with annual fee and register requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of tax-exempt status (no Samoa-source income and no local business activity).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must verify via the annual declaration that the IC has no Samoan customers, no local employees, no warehousing in Samoa, and no income arising in Samoa; loss of this declaration forfeits the 0% tax status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, shareholders and beneficial owners register confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership information must be disclosed to the Registered Agent under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2018; nominee shareholding without disclosure of the ultimate FBA operator is a red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of the director and Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors, including non-resident directors, are personally bound by the declarations; digital or physical signature may be accepted through the agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-payment of the annual government fee: graduated late penalties imposed by the Registrar; continued default for 6 to 9 months exposes the IC to compulsory strike-off, forfeiture of assets, restoration costs, and personal liability of directors if the company continues trading after deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Company Income Tax Return (Form CIT-1) and financial statements; electronic filing through the Samoa Ministry for Revenue online filing platform (MfR e-Services).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly provisional tax instalments where the IC has any taxable Samoa-source income; a fully exempt IC is not required to lodge this form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., by 30 June for a 31 December year-end); final tax payment due on the same date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), name and address of the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An exempt IC that nevertheless triggers a Samoa-source income event (e.g., local retail supplies to Samoan consumers) must promptly register with the Ministry for Revenue through the Registered Agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Year of income: start and end dates of the accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies may use their home-country accounting year; the 6-month filing deadline runs from the declared year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross assessable income arising in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Samoa-source income (e.g., sales to Samoan residents, services performed in Samoa); offshore Amazon FBA sales to non-Samoan customers remain exempt IC income and are excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income including qualifying International Company offshore profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The exemption applies strictly to non-Samoa-source income; co-mingled FBA marketplace receipts must be supported by transactional records, delivery logs and payment-rail evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions: arm's length expenses directly incurred in earning assessable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to related parties, including royalties and management fees to affiliated companies, require arm's length substantiation; the Commissioner may apply Section 101 of the Income Tax Act 2015 to adjust non-arm's length prices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the 27% rate net of credits and provisional tax paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provisional instalments already paid are credited; any balance is payable by the statutory deadline to avoid interest accrual.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature of director or authorized representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False declarations attract civil shortfall penalties and criminal liability; non-resident directors may be held personally accountable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: default assessment on estimated income plus statutory late-filing uplift; late payment: monthly compound interest at the gazetted rate (commonly 1% per month) and a late-payment penalty; deliberate evasion or false statements: shortfall penalty of up to 100% of tax avoided, criminal fines, and imprisonment for responsible officers.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Samoa's Income Tax Act 2015 does not impose a withholding tax on dividend distributions, whether to resident or non-resident shareholders; an exempt International Company may distribute profits to its non-resident beneficial owners free of Samoan dividend WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains a limited double tax agreement (DTA) network. Where a DTA applies, the beneficial owner claiming relief must: (i) obtain an official Samoa Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the Ministry for Revenue; (ii) supply the TRC, the counterparty treaty form (e.g., IRS Form W-8BEN or the applicable foreign revenue form), and documentary proof of beneficial ownership to the source-country payer or revenue authority; and (iii) file a refund claim in the source country if treaty-rate tax was over-withheld, within the foreign statutory limitation period. For distributions from a Samoan IC, the 0% domestic dividend WHT makes inbound treaty relief largely unnecessary.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax under the Income Tax Act 2015: 15% on interest and 15% on royalties paid to non-residents deriving Samoa-source income. Applicable DTA treaty rates may reduce these rates (commonly to 0%-10%) where a valid TRC is submitted. An exempt International Company with no Samoa-source income and no local payors is outside the Samoan WHT net for offshore royalty and interest payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No codified statutory Local File / Master File threshold exists in Samoa. Prudent compliance benchmark: associated-party cross-border transactions exceeding WST 100,000 (approximately USD 38,000) per fiscal year should be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation applying the arm's length principle under Section 101 of the Income Tax Act 2015.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa's International Companies Act 1987, as amended by the Economic Substance Requirements regime effective from 2019, requires an International Company carrying on a relevant activity (including IP holding, banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and other activities aligned with OECD/EU substance criteria) to demonstrate real economic presence in Samoa: Samoan registered office, board meetings held in Samoa, adequate staff and operating expenditure, and core income-generating activities performed in Samoa. A cross-border Amazon FBA e-commerce IC claiming the 0% tax-exempt status must maintain this substance, otherwise the tax exemption is denied and the company is subject to Registrar enforcement, penalties, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming the International Company tax-exempt zone status while earning Samoa-source income, such as retail sales delivered to Samoan consumers, local FBA warehousing in Samoa, or services physically performed in Samoa; failing to file a CIT return where a domestic taxable presence arises; concealing Amazon FBA proceeds in the exempt IC to escape the 27% corporate rate and VAGST obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner of Revenue may issue a default assessment on estimated income, apply a shortfall penalty of up to 100% of the tax avoided, and charge compound monthly interest; criminal prosecution for intentional evasion or falsification of records carries statutory fines and imprisonment for responsible officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false exemption declarations or direct the diversion of Samoa-source revenue into the exempt IC are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax; the Samoan High Court may issue asset-freezing orders, forfeiture orders, travel bans, and director disqualification upon conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Samoan International Company with nominee directors, no Samoan registered office substance, no board meetings, no staff, and no expenditure, and using it solely as a tax-free re-invoicing shell for Amazon FBA profits and family trust assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withdrawal of the IC tax exemption; the Registrar may impose economic substance non-compliance penalties, require rectification, and strike the company off the register where substance is absent for consecutive reporting periods; assets may escheat to the Registrar upon strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and licensed Registered Agents facilitating a sham substance arrangement face fines and de-registration; upon winding-up, directors may be personally liable for the IC's debts where trading was fraudulent or the shell was used to mislead revenue authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with undisclosed beneficial ownership by Chinese-speaking family-trust beneficiaries, routing Amazon Pay, Stripe, or Airwallex settlement funds through third-party accounts, or using the Samoan IC bank account to launder proceeds from unrelated illicit commerce without customer due diligence and beneficial ownership filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 and the Beneficial Ownership Act 2018: substantial financial penalties, confiscation of funds and property, and imprisonment for money laundering offences; continued non-disclosure of beneficial owners triggers regulatory enforcement, bank account freezes, and enhanced FATF/APG scrutiny.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permit laundering or conceal beneficial ownership are personally exposed to criminal conviction, confiscation orders, travel bans, and extradition; the corporate veil may be pierced to recover illicit proceeds from individual controllers of the IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing / Non-Arm's Length Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated royalties, management fees, or above-market intercompany charges from onshore operating entities into the exempt Samoan IC without economic substance, or transacting with the IC at non-arm's length prices to shift profit into the 0% tax-exempt zone.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner of Revenue may exercise Section 101 of the Income Tax Act 2015 to substitute arm's length amounts, disallow excessive deductions, reassess the shifted margin at the 27% corporate rate, and apply shortfall penalties and monthly interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who architect an abusive transfer pricing scheme may be jointly and severally liable for the additional tax and penalties; the arrangement is treated as tax evasion where documentation is fabricated, exposing directors to criminal sanctions, disqualification, and cross-border exchange of information under Samoa's DTA and tax transparency commitments.
